items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Bob Gioga was the director? [INTERVIEWEE] No, that was before. Tony Ferrina, and I think Gerry played a short time. I know he did with the Claude Thornhill band but I’m not sure about that.

ctx.x: That was a nice sax section. You, him, Richie Kamuca, and Holman was the fourth tenor player. Bob Gioga was the director?
No, that was before. Tony Ferrina, and I think Gerry played a short time. I know he did with the Claude Thornhill band but I’m not sure about that.
